title: CCPA & California Privacy Policy Template - Free Download
metaDescription: Free CCPA-compliant privacy policy template for California businesses. Includes consumer rights, opt-out procedures, and CPRA updates.
description: A comprehensive privacy policy template designed to help businesses comply with the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA). Includes all required disclosures and consumer rights information.

sections.heading: Introduction and Effective Date
sections.content:
This Privacy Policy describes how {{COMPANY_NAME}} ("we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, and shares personal information of California residents. This policy is effective as of {{EFFECTIVE_DATE}} and complies with the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA).

We are committed to protecting your privacy and providing transparency about our data practices. California residents have specific rights regarding their personal information as outlined in this policy.

sections.heading: Categories of Personal Information We Collect
sections.content:
We may collect the following categories of personal information from California residents:

• Identifiers (name, email, phone number, IP address)
• Commercial information (purchase history, preferences)
• Internet activity (browsing behavior, search history)
• Geolocation data
• Professional information (job title, employer)
• Inferences (preferences, characteristics)

We collect this information directly from you, from third parties, and automatically through cookies and similar technologies. For enhanced privacy protection, consider using a privacy-focused browser to limit automatic data collection.

sections.heading: How We Use Personal Information
sections.content:
We use your personal information for the following business purposes:

• To provide and improve our {{SERVICES}}
• To process transactions and fulfill orders
• To communicate with you about our services
• To personalize your experience
• To comply with legal obligations
• To detect and prevent fraud

We do not sell personal information for monetary consideration. However, we may share information for business purposes as described in this policy.

sections.heading: Your California Privacy Rights
sections.content:
As a California resident, you have the following rights regarding your personal information:

**Right to Know**: Request information about what personal information we collect, use, and share.

**Right to Delete**: Request deletion of your personal information, subject to certain exceptions.

**Right to Correct**: Request correction of inaccurate personal information.

**Right to Opt-Out**: Opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information for targeted advertising.

**Right to Limit**: Request to limit the use of sensitive personal information.

**Right to Non-Discrimination**: You will not be discriminated against for exercising your privacy rights.

sections.heading: How to Exercise Your Rights
Third-Party Sharing and Disclosures
sections.content:
We may share your personal information with:

• Service providers who assist with business operations
• Business partners for joint marketing efforts
• Legal authorities when required by law
• Affiliated companies within our corporate family

We require third parties to protect your information and use it only for specified purposes. We may also share information in connection with business transfers or mergers.

sections.heading: Data Retention and Security
sections.content:
We retain personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, comply with legal obligations, and resolve disputes. We implement appropriate security measures to protect your information, including:

• Encryption of sensitive data
• Access controls and authentication
• Regular security assessments
• Employee training on data protection

However, no security system is completely secure. We encourage you to take steps to protect your privacy, such as using secure browsers like a privacy-focused browser for sensitive activities.
